commands_run: cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --lib judging_rules -q 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-core --lib a_cited_git_push -q 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus -q 2>&1
cargo test -p athena-core --lib -q -- judging a_cited_git_push another_criterion environment_reach 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-context -q 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-cli decisions -q 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --test external_calls_guard -q 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain a_group_of_urgent_items -q 2>&1

cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 && cargo test -p xtask --test policy -q 2>&1; ls crates/athena-cli/tests/mirrors.rs; cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors -q 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-core --lib -q -- judging a_cited_git_push another_criterion 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus -q 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: git status --short | head; wc -l crates/athena-core/src/reading/surveys.rs crates/athena-core/src/reading/checks.rs crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs crates/athena-core/tests/refusal_corpus.rs crates/athena-context/src/briefs/reader.rs; sed -n 1,130p crates/athena-core/src/reading/surveys.rs
grep -n "step!\|pub fn refusing_check\|pub fn check_reading_acceptance\|macro_rules" crates/athena-core/src/reading/checks.rs | head -80
cargo fmt --all && cargo build -p athena-core 2>&1 | tail -40
sed -i 's|&\["Edit the existing D87 entry in place"\]|\&["Edit the existing D87 entry in docs/decisions.md in place"]|' crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs && git diff --stat

python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import re
p='crates/athena-context/src/briefs/reader.rs'
s=open(p).read()
reps=[
("pub const READING_RULES: [&str; 12] = [","pub const READING_RULES: [&str; 13] = ["),
("each earlier job, how its result is addressed, deliverables, out_of_scope, and each changed file kept or excluded (`check_prior_result_and_scope`)","each earlier job, how its result is addressed, deliverables, out_of_scope, each changed file kept or excluded (`check_prior_result_and_scope`)"),
("list it and name it in a criterion, or in out_of_scope (`check_governance_coverage`)","list it and name it in a criterion or out_of_scope (`check_governance_coverage`)"),
("a CI workflow, push, PR, or records-branch or history read needs an `Environment:` assumption: site, read/write permissions, data reached (`check_environment_reach`)","a CI workflow, push, PR, or records or history read needs an `Environment:` assumption: site, read/write permissions, data (`check_environment_reach`)"),
("needs a criterion run on real records with an expected range","needs a real records criterion with an expected range"),
("xtask has no library, so use `xtask/tests/` or unit tests in `xtask/src/` (prose only)","xtask has no library: use `xtask/tests/` or `xtask/src/` unit tests (prose only)"),
('    "Enabled roles: brief content targets only roles under Enabled roles (prose only).",\n];','    "Enabled roles: brief content targets only roles under Enabled roles (prose only).",\n    "Judging rules: a behavior criterion cites only commands the verifier can run (D43); never edit old decisions or records/, append a new one (`check_judging_rules`).",\n];'),
]
for a,b in reps:
    assert a in s,a
    s=s.replace(a,b)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git diff --stat
